violations.why: The higher-priority urchin ISR can preempt yarrow between the read and the write of v_falcon++. The increment then overwrites urchin's value with a stale one.
Urchin can reset v_falcon to 0 between yarrow's increment and its check. The check then sees 0 instead of the value yarrow just wrote.
Urchin's write can land between yarrow's two reads of v_falcon. The two reads then see different values.
Urchin can preempt grove after it sets v_falcon to 1 and reset it to 0. Grove's check then fails, though it just wrote 1.
